<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem claims users must alter established processes to use the platform, disrupting efficiency. I checked the five most similar items: story 4131 (workspace administration, completed) covers permissions/settings/team management, not process flexibility; 4133 (classifier confidence threshold, unstarted) and 4137 (reporting navigation, unstarted) address unrelated features; the two Notion roadmap pages cover reporting navigation and policyholder milestone notifications, neither of which addresses adapting to users' existing workflows. No completed story or roadmap item solves the same core problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
